notes: Seed URL www.co.hidalgo.tx.us/elections/ returned HTTP 403; the county elections site is www.hidalgocounty.us/elections. Its election pages (2024 General 3318, 2026 Joint Primary 3456, 2026 Runoff 3477) link to Clarity EIDs 122498, 125934 and 126201. The county's Clarity elections.json lists elections only through 2020, so the check 1 script reported 'not listed'; the same reading (current_ver.txt, electionsettings.json versions, every reports/detailxml.zip, Timestamp and precincts with nonzero votes, using the script's own read_detail and on_election_night functions) was run on those EIDs from a scratch runner. Vote type for election day is named 'Election'. Precinct numbers before 9:21 PM in 2024 were early and mail only; election-day precinct votes first at 11:19 PM CST (2024), 9:29 PM CST (2026 primary), 8:28 PM CDT (2026 runoff). Unreadable (HTTP 404) versions: 5 (2024), 7 (2026 primary), 1 (2026 runoff), all before election night or after it. County pages also post later PCT by PCT and cumulative results documents (DocumentCenter). Wayback branch origin/wayback-data was not present when checked (not needed).
tag_rationale: All three elections are LIVE by check 1 (Clarity update log), so the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with confidence high.
